programme: ShotSight Virtual Shooter — Learn to Shoot

latest_verified_ci.note: Full L0->L3 regression is green through strengthened privileged-alias containment, Ellis Experience/Satisfaction foundation, and executable Ellis Human Vision V1. The human-vision numerics remain provisional SHOTSIGHT_HYPOTHESIS pending human calibration.

governing_rule: ORACLE KNOWS. SHOOTER PERCEIVES, BELIEVES, PLANS, ACTS, REMEMBERS AND LEARNS.
shooting_axiom: GOOD SHOOTING IS CONTINUOUS PERCEPTUAL COUPLING BETWEEN TARGET AND GUN: READ THE LINE -> MATCH THE SPEED -> APPLY THE METHOD -> TRIGGER -> FOLLOW THROUGH.
anti_cheat_audit_status: GREEN_THROUGH_L3_HUMAN_VISUAL_ACQUISITION_AT_CI_33973239021; EXPERIENCE_RECORDS_AND_HUMAN_VISION_REJECT_PRIVILEGED_FIELDS_AND_ALIASES; UNRESOLVED_FLASH_STREAK_ACQUIRING_REACQUIRING_PHASES DO_NOT EXPOSE A POLICY_READY TARGET CENTRE; TARGET_SEED_SCENARIO_SEED_MISS_DISTANCE_TRUE_RANGE_FUTURE_PATH_INTERCEPT_PELLET_TOF_REQUIRED_LEAD_AND_DIRECT_CORRECTION_REMAIN OUTSIDE LEARNER POLICY_AND_MEMORY
active_hypotheses: Good shooting is continuous perceptual coupling: read the live line, match gun speed, apply method, trigger, and follow through.
A demonstrated clay is a presentation prior rather than a deterministic trajectory; each live clay must be re-read as it varies with launch/aerodynamic/wind disturbance.
Binary reward support is sparse but demonstrably present in the current shooter-visible architecture.

Ellis's complete apprenticeship — perception, belief, intention, movement, outcome, self-diagnosis, intervention and later result — is scientifically valuable and should become a future causal training corpus for Chiron.
Shot Quality and Break Quality should remain distinct learner-visible assessments; a Satisfaction Score may improve learning by reinforcing good dynamic execution without redefining a miss as a hit.
Satisfaction must be ablated against binary-only learning and rejected if it improves shaped score without improving held-out breaks, transfer, calibration or robust movement.

Pull-away is now the primary next-method learning hypothesis because acquire/connect/match/separate/trigger/follow-through creates an interpretable adaptation loop; maintained lead remains a comparator/specialist method rather than a primary teaching assumption.
Human-plausible post-shot chip/fragment/coach/video/Sense evidence may later support coarse intuitive correction, but must remain delayed, noisy and non-oracle.

A newly released fast clay should initially yield human-analogous transient/streak/region evidence and only later a resolved-but-uncertain track; expertise may improve expectation and interpretation but must not remove the sensory acquisition constraint.
Human-analogous acquisition should create a measurable information-versus-runway trade-off: waiting can improve line/speed belief but consumes shooting time and available movement.
Constant and phase-dependent relationship representations remain competing hypotheses; prior diagnostic 5 constant-control hits versus 4 phase-trajectory hits does not support phase superiority.

Human kinematic limits, follow-through duration, coupling tolerances, visual acquisition timings and pursuit parameters remain SHOTSIGHT_HYPOTHESIS / PROVISIONAL_METHOD_KINEMATICS pending Sense/video/eye-tracking calibration.
negative_findings: Static one-dimensional maintained-lead separation had no binary reward support after expanded diagnosis; motor travel was not the primary limitation.

L3 had been over-projecting delayed observations by 40 ms because a 120 ms belief horizon was used for an 80 ms-old observation while motor anticipation was also applied separately; this semantic bug is fixed.
After the timing fix the static representation still produced zero hits, so the fix did not manufacture success.

Shooter-visible trigger timing expansion produced 100 physical follow-through shots across 1512 attempts and still zero proxy hits; timing inside the planned break region alone was not the missing ingredient.

The learner-side geometry/time-alignment audit found and fixed a 16.7 ms frame/state mismatch; a fresh post-fix diagnostic still produced 0/660 hits, so corrected geometry alone did not establish reward support.
Quasi-continuous low-discrepancy constant relationship exploration on seed base 361000 produced 0/1024 hits; coarse action quantisation alone was not the missing ingredient.

The first phase-dependent relationship diagnostic did not outperform its constant-relationship control: 4/1024 versus 5/1024 proxy hits on the same bank. Do not elevate phase-changing maintained lead into a universal rule from this result.
Reward support is population-sensitive and sparse: 0/1024 constant attempts on seed base 361000 versus 5/1024 on seed base 371000. Do not post-hoc tune to rewarded action identities.
Do not widen the hit proxy, inject referee miss gradients, expose oracle lead, or treat the 55 mm engineering proxy as real-world break probability.
Satisfaction is not yet evidence-backed as a useful learner objective; it remains experimental until an ON/OFF ablation improves held-out shooting outcomes or robust process without reward hacking.
The Human Vision V1 numerical defaults are not established clay-shooting physiology and must not be presented as universal human acquisition or pursuit thresholds.
next_action: Route the primary pull-away learner through ELLIS_VISUAL_EVIDENCE_V1 and add a policy-boundary test that fails if the pull-away learner consumes raw unresolved ShooterObservation az/el coordinates before TRACKING. Extend ELLIS_EXPERIENCE_RECORD_V1 to preserve acquisition phase/score, streak-vs-resolved state, observation span, contrast/clutter/occlusion, selective waiting and reacquisition. Then begin genuine pull-away-primary hit/miss learning on explicit non-sealed train/calibration/held-out populations. Preserve binary-only as truth/control; compare memory ON/OFF, Satisfaction ON/OFF, human-analogous vision vs legacy clean-point observation, and selective wait ON/OFF. Never initialise from prior rewarded action identities or oracle geometry, and do not scale to 100k until reproducible held-out learning is demonstrated.
